summary: Qazax has a population of 96,700 across a 636.7 km² area with a density of 138 residents per km². The district records 1.96 pharmacies and 10.75 grocery stores per 10,000 residents, alongside 2.79 hospitals per 10,000 residents. The transport network includes 1 rail station and 8 bus stops. Road infrastructure has a known paved share of 2.7% against the national median of 4.35%.
